events.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE — NEW ABILITIES, GRAPPLE HOOK & CO-OP FIXES
events.summary: BIG DEMO UPDATE — NEW ABILITIES, GRAPPLE HOOK & CO-OP FIXES Great news — the RIFTFALL demo has been fully updated with a huge batch of new features, fixes and polish! NEW: SQUAD ABILITIESYour operator now brings their own gear to the fight. Deploy a Sentry Turret or throw up a Shield Barricade with a single press of Q — unlockable and upgradable as you progress. Every hero plays differently now. NEW: GRAPPLE HOOKDouble-tap your melee key (F) to fire a grapple, hook an enemy and drag them straigh

events.title: HELL IS NOW PORTABLE — RIFTFALL ON STEAM DECK
events.summary: The rift goes handheld.RIFTFALL now runs on Steam Deck — tested on real hardware, full controller support, every weapon and every arena playable on the go. No keyboard. No mouse. Just you, six guns, and twenty levels of hell in your hands.WHAT'S NEWFull controller support — sticks, triggers, bumpers, d-pad and grips, all mapped. Move, aim, fire, alt-fire, jump, dash, melee, grenades, revive.All six weapons on the pad — including the RIFT SNIPER and the FLAMER, now bound to their own buttons inst

events.title: RIFTFALL DEMO — YOU GET ONE HOUR WAR.
events.summary: Sixty minutes. No level locks, no "first three maps then buy it." The whole game is unlocked — twenty arenas, six weapons, every boss that wants you dead. The only thing counting down is you.Grab the Breacher. Grab the Vulcan, the Arc Rail, the Flamer. Kill a dragon. Kill a tripod the size of a cathedral. Ride a train. Get eaten by something in the dark and try again, faster.When the clock hits zero, it stops. What you did with the hour is on you.Hell was a cakewalk. This is the main course.
